apps.name: iBuilder
apps.subtitle: Switch games, built on your iPhone
apps.localizedDescription:
iBuilder turns a Switch game dump you own into a native iOS build on the iPhone itself: extract, rewrite, translate the shaders, sign and play. Experimental: results differ per game.

No game, firmware or key is included or downloaded. Use it only with your own games and the prod.keys of your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple.

What the app can do depends on the certificate you install it with: see the README.

versions.localizedDescription:
> [!WARNING]
> No game, firmware or key is included or downloaded. Use iBuilder only with games you own and the `prod.keys` dumped from your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple.

**Fixes**
- The first build of a game now waits for, and includes, its update and DLC (it could start while the update was still downloading)
- A game's settings sheet no longer grows wider than the screen
- The selected tab no longer draws its icon over its label
- NAS listing: updates and DLC are classified and grouped under their game; a base game on the iPhone offers its update from the NAS
- Review fixes (r5): NAS cover reads, free space never read as 0, warm-up wait bounded, discarding a paused rebuild keeps the working build, boot-loop guard on device, stricter no-spawn gate

**Install**: SideStore source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Absenti/iBuilder/main/apps.json`, or the `.ipa` below. Bundle id `dev.ibuilder.app`, iOS 26+. Assets: the `.ipa`, its `.sha256`, and `.ipa.verify.tar.gz` (the verifier that checked it: 236 checks passed).
First public release. No game, firmware or key included: use only games you own and keys from your own console.
